spans.s: N. of a man, man of Ḍittha's kind (?; ‘a handsome dark-complexioned man conversant with every branch of learning’, L.; cf. डवित्थ and डाम्भिट्ट), Pāṇ. v, 1, 119,
, Pat. (also -ता f. -त्व n. ‘an act of a man of Ḍittha's kind’), i, 2, 45, Kāś.; Bādar. ii, 4, 20, Sch.; Kpr.; Sāh. ii, 4/5;
डित्थ—ता f., ‘an act of a man of Ḍittha's kind’
डित्थ—त्व n., ‘an act of a man of Ḍittha's kind’
